verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਲੇਖ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach hukam sach lekh hai sach kaaran kar khel rachaiaa|

en.bdb: The order of the Lord is true, His writ is true and from the true cause He has created the creation as His sport.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaaran karate vas hai viralai dhaa oh karai karaiaa|

en.bdb: All the causes are under the control of the creator but He accepts the deeds of any rare devotee.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਈ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: so kih hor na ma(n)giee khasamai dhaa bhaanaa tis bhaiaa|

en.bdb: The devotee who has loved the will of the Lord, does not beg anything from any one else.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: khasamai evai bhaavadhaa bhagat vachhal hui biradh sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: Now the Lord also loves to accept the prayer of the devotee because protection of the devotee is His nature.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਿਵ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh liv kaaran karataa karadhaa aaiaa|

en.bdb: The devotees who keep their consciousness absorbed in the Word in the holy congregation, know well that the creator Lord is the perennial cause of all causes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਤੀਤ ਜਗਿ ਵਰ ਸਰਾਪ ਦਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: baal subhai ateet jag var saraap dhaa bharam chukaiaa|

en.bdb: The devotee like the innocent child remains detached from the world and keeps himself free from delusions of boons and curses.
He receives the fruit in accordance with his desert.'
